trailhead.label: Fountain in the hamlet of Le Fornet, the board’s start

cautions: The farm track runs beside the young Isère: keep your dog out of the fast, cold water.
Cows may graze along the track in summer: keep your dog on a lead near the herds.
High ground at about 1,925–2,110 m: quick weather changes and strong sun.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.

textIt.Fornet waterfall loop from Le Fornet: Anello della cascata del Fornet da Le Fornet
textIt.Fountain in the hamlet of Le Fornet, the: La fontana nella frazione di Le Fornet, punto di partenza della scheda ufficiale
textIt.The farm track runs beside the young Isè: La strada agricola corre accanto alla giovane Isère: tieni il cane fuori dall'acqua fredda e veloce.
textIt.Cows may graze along the track in summer: D'estate le mucche possono pascolare lungo la strada: vicino alle mandrie tieni il cane al guinzaglio.
textIt.High ground at about 1,925–2,110 m: quic: Terreno alto, a circa 1.925–2.110 m: il tempo cambia in fretta e il sole è forte.
